editorial.blurb: Coalfire's thin, bubbly coal-fired pizzas and welcoming atmosphere make it a beloved neighborhood spot worth the occasional wait.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive with time to spare—service can be slow despite quick pizza delivery, and consider ordering at the bar like locals do for a faster experience.

topDishes.note: Thin, bubbly crust from the coal fire
Tasted great and pairs well with drinks
